versions.content: {DRAFT} If EthTrcvWakeupSleepOnDataline Enabled is set to TRUE, the requested transceiver mode is still ETH_MODE_DOWN and SleepFail.Indication was reported less than EthTrcvSleepRequestNumberOfRepetitions, the Ethernet Transceiver driver shall trigger a sleep request according to the specificati on of OA TC10 (see [ 23 ] ) after EthTrcvSleepRequestRepetitionPeriod has been elapsed.

If EthTrcvWakeupSleepOnDatalineEnabled is set to TRUE, the requested transceiver mode is still ETH_MODE_DOWN and SleepFail.Indication was reported less than EthTrcvSleepRequestNumberOfRepetitions, the Ethernet Transceiver driver shall trigger a sleep request according to the specification of OA TC10 (see [3]) after EthTrcvSleepRequestRepetitionPeriod has been elapsed.

If EthTrcvWakeupSleepOnDatalineEnabled is set to TRUE, the requested transceiver mode is still ETH_MODE_DOWN and SleepFail.Indication was reported less than EthTrcvSleepRequestNumberOfRepetitions, the Ethernet Transceiver driver shall trigger a sleep request according to the specification of OA TC10 (see [3]) after EthTrcvSleepRequestRepetitionPeriod has been elapsed.
